thread:
sasha (SRE): quick sync after the morning outage affecting /v1/generate tail latency. PM posted a short postmortem draft in #incidents. we need to lock owners for SLO/SLA tweaks and the follow-up action list.

leo (Infra): observed repeated KV cache evictions + a curious autoscaler cooldown spike around 02:10 UTC. recommendation: temporarily widen p95 SLO from 200ms -> 260ms for 14 days to avoid noisy alerts while we patch. open to alternatives.

mira (ProdEng): fine with temporary change if we have firm guardrails. propose: 14-day concession, must include an automated dashboard and an alert on error-budget burn > 5%/24h. owner for mitigation plan: mira. ETA: 9 business days.

todd (SRE): i'll build the dashboard and add event annotations for the last 4 incidents so we can correlate. i'll include a burn-rate panel and the autoscale step latencies. ETA: 48-72h.

sasha (SRE): summary so far: mira -> mitigation & RFC (9d), todd -> dashboards + annotations (3d), leo -> infra policy/scale review (2d). i'll file the SLO change and notify partners.

leo (Infra): will add a metric and alert for kv eviction rate > 4% over 5m. ETA: 24h. also tightening scale-down policy to be less aggressive on small pools - PR in 3 days.

mira (ProdEng): mitigation breakdown: increase default cache TTL for hot prefixes, add background prefetch for new replicas, and add admission control under load. will post RFC with rollout plan and canary checklist.

sasha (SRE): ops-bot, please create a tracker for the exception window and link to the postmortem.

ops-bot: created ticket SRE-2044 "SLO concession + follow-ups: /v1/generate latency" and linked to this thread [32m:white_check_mark:[0m

todd (SRE): dashboard panel names planned: "/v1/generate p95 (post-incident)", "Autoscale step latency", "KV eviction rate", "Error budget burn". will push layout and invite reviewers.

sasha (SRE): decision items: 1) Apply temporary p95 SLO bump to 260ms for 14d (approved). 2) Dashboard + alerts (todd, 3d). 3) Infra scale policy change + eviction alert (leo, 2d). 4) Mitigation RFC + patch (mira, 9d). 5) Revert SLO after canary verification and update runbook (sasha).

leo (Infra): who can run the canary next week? need someone to execute and validate warmup behavior.

mira (ProdEng): i'll run the canary and document steps in SRE-2044 by EOD.

sasha (SRE): adding a recurring-note in the runbook: if we see 3 kv-related latency incidents in 60d we switch to hotfix-first mode. flagging this as a recurring-pattern threshold.

todd (SRE): ack, will annotate the dashboard to surface recurrence trends.

mira (ProdEng): also proposing we add a metric for worker warmup latency distribution so we can see the cold-start contribution. will include in RFC.

sasha (SRE): thanks. i'll open the SLO PR and tag @leo and @todd for review. once merged, i'll post the customer-facing note and ops channel alert.

ops-bot: reminder set: check progress in 3 days for dashboards and infra alerting.

sasha (SRE): keeping this thread open for updates; will post links to PRs and SRE-2044 as they land.
